result.title: D3-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Dynamic Mode Decomposition
result.summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images and videos, but every sampling step requires a full network evaluation. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing or forecasting network outputs across steps, but common approaches use per-model calibrated skip criteria or maintain per-layer prediction histories. We present D3-Cache, which applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to Diffusion sampling: it fits DMD to a short history of exact velocities and forecasts only the velocity that the scheduler consumes. A horizon-aware gate decides when to skip: whenever the network is evaluated, its output is compared with the forecast for that step, and the larger the error, the sooner the network is evaluated again, up to a cap on consecutive skipped steps. D3-Cache requires no training or per-model offline calibration curve and adds negligible memory. It shares one history length and risk tolerance across the four evaluated models. On four state-of-the-art image and video models, D3-Cache achieves speedups of 2.6-3.8x with high fidelity to the base model output.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 D3-Cache：用 Dynamic Mode Decomposition 拟合近期精确 velocity 的短历史，仅预测 scheduler 所需的下一个 velocity；并以「horizon-aware gate」按预测误差决定何时重新调用网络、最多连续跳过多少步，实现免训练、免逐模型标定的扩散采样加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属图像/视频扩散加速而非 VLM 推理，但其「用历史状态动力学外推下一步、再以误差门控决定重算时机」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新与 STOP/计算分配的停止决策提供可核查的类比线索。
